mintAuthority.summary: Gate GUSD uses OpenZeppelin AccessControl on a UUPS ERC1967 proxy. MINTER_ROLE is held by one EOA; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE are held by a second EOA with no timelock.

sources.label: Gate GUSD proxy creation and role initialization

controls.label: Gate GUSD MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: RoleGranted(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0..., 0x83393a...) was emitted by the proxy creation transaction at block 23237330. At block 25526610, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x83393a...) returned true and eth_getCode returned empty; the complete role-event history contains no revocation.

controls.label: Gate GUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: The proxy creation transaction at block 23237330 granted this EOA both DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. At block 25526610, both hasRole checks returned true and eth_getCode returned empty; the complete role-event history contains no revocation.

controls.label: Gate GUSD Ethereum token proxy
controls.evidence: At block 25526610, the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xC181Faf98a90993BBa78Af4A9d5DDe37D3DbAdAF, while the admin and beacon slots were zero. The implementation's proxiableUUID() returned the EIP-1967 implementation slot.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526610, the UUPS proxy implementation was 0xC181Faf98a90993BBa78Af4A9d5DDe37D3DbAdAF with zero EIP-1967 admin and beacon slots. The implementation returned the standard proxiableUUID and exposes upgradeToAndCall guarded by UPGRADER_ROLE. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked enumeration from proxy creation block 23237330 identifies EOA 0x83393a... as the sole minter and EOA 0x191af8... as both default admin and upgrader, with no revocations; current hasRole and eth_getCode reads confirmed both identities. On 2026-07-15, Gate's GUSD product page was rechecked: it makes issuer reserve claims but provides no dated recurring independent supply-to-reserve report or prudential issuer registry, so reconciliation remains unknown and the no-delay issuer-controlled mint is economically unbounded. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the no-delay issuer minter and upgrader remain unbounded, and pooled self-reported exchange reserves neither reconcile GUSD liabilities nor establish supervision.
